ideas.pitch: A hyper-local coordination app for the Digdoh area that groups students and faculty commuting from nearby transit hubs into shared auto-rickshaws, reducing daily commute costs and traffic congestion.
ideas.title: Digdoh Campus Local Transit Coordination Network
ideas.why_it_could_win: It directly targets a logistical pain point familiar to the local organisers, students, and attendees travelling into Digdoh for the event, matching the pattern of solving a problem judges feel themselves.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered submission and summarization tool built specifically for the Grand Innovation Challenge closing ceremony, categorizing project pitches in real-time for judges.
ideas.title: PCE Event Live Engagement and Q&A Intelligence
ideas.why_it_could_win: It solves an immediate operational challenge for PCE organisers running a high-paced in-person event, capturing the attention of the judging panel through direct utility.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight mobile-first web app that allows local shops around Digdoh to log daily stock levels via quick voice notes and auto-generates restocking alerts.
ideas.title: Digdoh Regional Small Business Micro-Inventory Tracker
ideas.why_it_could_win: It demonstrates clear, measurable local economic impact for small businesses operating in the immediate vicinity of the venue.

ideas.pitch: A smart queueing and matching web tool that pairs student teams experiencing specific technical roadblocks at the venue with the most qualified mentor on site.
ideas.title: PCE Hackathon Mentor Routing Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: It addresses a chaotic reality of short 7-hour hackathons where mentor allocation is often bottlenecked, making it deeply relatable to everyone in the room.

ideas.pitch: A localized environmental monitoring dashboard aggregating open satellite and air quality data specifically for the industrial and semi-urban zones of Digdoh.
ideas.title: Digdoh Green Cover & Dust Monitoring Dashboard
ideas.why_it_could_win: It follows the proven pattern of regional environmental tracking, appealing to judges looking for tangible infrastructure and ecological monitoring solutions.
